assessment: R126b scheduler fairness fixed the ingress starvation observed in R126: no sink-overflow reconnects and final ingress backlog was 6.
The dominant failure moved to candidate fanout: 994177 candidate hits for 830 dependency updates and max_pending 78214.
Bank projection is viable but not sufficient as the primary fanout-control mechanism: 513/641 terminal projections were ready (~80%).

The current threshold query repeatedly wakes accounts already beyond their stored threshold; a pure crossing-index replacement was considered but is not safe by itself because thresholds depend on other bank prices.
decision: Do not qualify R126b. For the first-euro/long-tail path, pivot to eva01-style affected-bank account collection plus exact health evaluation; retain threshold-index work only as a later race optimization after correctness/performance proof.
